items.kw: TRUMP Lost Congress. History Says This Happens Next (in 30 Minutes)
items.desc: Trump just lost Congress. History has already run this experiment five times, and every president faced the same three choices: fight it, deal with it, or sink with it. On 3 November 2026, Democrats flipped seven Senate seats and took both chambers. So what happens next? We go back more than 100 years to find out. Woodrow Wilson lost Congress in 1918, fought Henry Cabot Lodge over the Treaty of Versailles and watched his party get crushed. Harry Truman was told to resign in 1946, called the "Do-Nothing Congress" back on Turnip Day, rode 22,000 miles by train and held up "Dewey Defeats Truman".
